summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Report vocal → Module 1' feature. Logged in as PRO admin, opened dossier 2a62630c, navigated to Module 1 tab, clicked new 'Reporter l'entrevue vocale' button — Amorce accept/refuse panel opened with correct title, correct 2 proposals (employes_quebec=40 FR, pct_ca=70 EN), correct source and language notes. Refuse+Apply works, toast confirms 1 field pre-filled (only accepted proposal). Regression check: Web enrich button opens same panel with original 'Propositions issues de la recherche Web' title (not carried over from amorce). All acceptance criteria met.

issues: window.confirm dialog appears even without user edits when switching tabs — dirtyRef.current gets set to true on initial StagePanel mount. Not a blocker (Playwright auto-accepts) but harms UX. Consider tracking dirty only after real user input.

critical_code_review_comments: DossierDetail confirmLeave() dialog fires spuriously on tab-switch; investigate onDirtyChange getting called during initial hydration in StagePanel.
WebEnrichPanel title 'Réponses de l'entrevue vocale (amorce mobile)' and 'Propositions issues de la recherche Web' correctly toggle via panelKind state — good pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'Report vocal → Module 1' works end-to-end. Note: tab switching in DossierDetail triggers a spurious 'unsaved changes' confirm() dialog when only navigating between tabs after loading StagePanel — Playwright script must attach a dialog handler that auto-accepts. Panel content is rendered via WebEnrichPanel; the title element is not an h2/h3 but a text node in a header container — use panel.innerText or a specific selector rather than h2/h3.
